title: An ending changes the view of fairness

captions.physics: Ending an earlier form of action

meaning: Shared closure of an earlier form for proportion can emotionally become a suspension of an earlier judgement about shared experience.
text: Death in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through shared actions that end an earlier form or phase. Justice in energy connects motivation with attention to contributions, restrictions and consequences for both people. The Hanged Man in emotions adds the experience of suspended judgement, when a familiar view temporarily fails to explain events. The overall tone can therefore be thoughtful: you are already completing an ending in proportion to the actual situation, while emotionally seeing the experience differently from before those final practical actions.

For example, you finish preparing a substantial family archive together. When returning documents, you recognise who supplied them and who needs copies. During the process, one person’s quiet work becomes visible as more time-consuming than previously assumed. **We are ending the activity and experiencing differently what we once considered equal participation.** The new perspective concerns an emotional assessment of experience, although the practical order of returning materials is already clear.

A difficulty arises if the new understanding becomes a demand to revise the entire history immediately according to one account. Proportion gives way to a final verdict, while emotional suspension becomes compulsory. The Hanged Man guarantees no identical view and requires no endless uncertainty. Justice as motivation makes no calculation infallible. Death ends a particular form while each person’s assessment of what happened can still develop, without invalidating the practical closure.
